properties.description: An on_disk module (tests/on_disk.rs). It reuses the hub-view test file's helpers (mint, serve, Session), made pub(super) for it. It drives the real binary as a --registry-root server behind a trusted gateway, with three designs minted over stdio.
properties.name: tests/through_a_hub_every_tool_runs_on_one_named_member.rs — five tests over a real registry with a hub and two members: the hub's listing declares `member`, the tools the trials could not aim run on the member named, every id in a routed reply is prefixed, add_release by a member's id lands there, `member` refused where it cannot be honoured
